title: Anti-Gravital knowledge graph (curated, manual)
description: Initial machine-readable knowledge graph for the workspace, per CLAUDE.md rule 33. Curated by hand from the Cargo manifests, the CLI and the DSL pipeline. The auto-generated per-project graph (derived from the DSL AST, persisted to .ag/knowledge-graph.json) is a separate Phase 6 deliverable and does not replace this file.

crates.name: ag-core
crates.role: Shield middleware pipeline (logging, rate-limit, CORS, auth-jwt, CSRF), core router/extractors, AgError.

crates.name: ag-dsl
crates.role: Anti-DSL compiler: lexer, parser, AST, semantic analysis, diagnostics, codegen.

crates.name: ag-cli
crates.role: The `ag` binary: scaffolding, dev server, build, DSL codegen, domains/mail/workers operations.

crates.name: ag-lsp
crates.role: Language Server Protocol tooling for the DSL (Phase 3).

crates.name: ag-wasm-host
crates.role: WASM host/runtime surface.

crates.name: ag-auth
crates.role: Authentication: JWT Ed25519, WebAuthn, OAuth, API keys, refresh blacklist. Consumes ag-mail for verification/recovery/magic-links (sixth dependency rule).

crates.name: ag-data
crates.role: Shared PostgreSQL pool, configuration, embedded migrations, the sanctioned sqlx boundary (AgTx).

crates.name: ag-realtime
crates.role: Event bus / realtime; optional event persistence and external NATS adapter.

crates.name: ag-cache
crates.role: Multilevel cache: L1 (moka) + optional native RESP2 server. External Redis L2 deferred (issue #144).

crates.name: ag-storage
crates.role: Object store: filesystem default, embedded HTTP server, optional S3 adapter, image processing, signed URLs.

crates.name: ag-observe
crates.role: Observability: tracing, Prometheus metrics. OTLP exporter deferred (issue #149).

crates.name: ag-mail
crates.role: Outbound transactional email + native MTA (feature mta). NOT a full mail server. ag-mail does NOT depend on ag-auth.

crates.name: ag-workers
crates.role: Background job execution: typed jobs, retries, DLQ, scheduling, worker pools. In-memory default, durable PostgreSQL opt-in via ag-data.

crates.name: ag-ui
crates.role: UI surface (optional).

crates.name: ag-cloud
crates.role: Deployment / cloud surface (Phase 5). Consumes ag-domains during `ag deploy` (seventh dependency rule).

crates.name: ag-ai
crates.role: AI integration surface (Phase 6); future knowledge-graph generation.

crates.name: ag-mobile
crates.role: Mobile client surface (optional).

crates.name: ag-migrate
crates.role: Migration tooling (optional).

crates.name: ag-domains
crates.role: DNS management (DnsProvider trait + adapters), ACME certificates, SPF/DKIM/DMARC. NOT a registrar; does not replace Terraform.

crates.name: ag-edge
crates.role: Edge data plane: hostname routing, SNI certificate selection, canonical/redirect policy (ADR-0012/RFC-0011).

dependency_rules: ag-core depends on no other Anti-Gravital crate.
ag-mail does NOT depend on ag-auth (sixth rule); ag-auth consumes ag-mail.
ag-workers does NOT depend on ag-edge; the allowed producer direction is ag-edge -> ag-workers behind the `producer` feature (issue #112).
ag-domains is consumed by ag-cloud during `ag deploy` (seventh rule); ag-domains does not depend on ag-cloud.

cli_commands.effect: Scaffold a new project from a template.
Run the development server with optional hot reload.
Run the DSL codegen over schema.ag.
Enqueue jobs and inspect the durable backend (ag-workers, needs DATABASE_URL).
